identity.title: Powered Industrial Truck Pre-Shift Inspection Log

scan.summary: This is an operating log documenting daily pre-shift inspections of a Toyota forklift (model BFGU25, unit FL-2, propane) from September 1-17, 2026, as required by OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178(q)(7). Each inspection records operator initials and whether 14 safety components passed inspection, with one defect noted: a non-working horn on September 9.
scan.freshness_note: This log is current through September 17, 2026. It covers the most recent month and the last entry is 12 days old as of the reading date (September 29, 2026). The company should continue maintaining this log with current daily entries.

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence in the identity and basic facts. The log clearly documents daily inspections as required by 29 CFR 1910.178(q)(7). One defect is documented (horn, Sep 9) but there is no evidence of follow-up corrective action or removal from service on that date—the truck was still inspected and used on subsequent days. The log format appears complete and appropriate for the requirement. Operator names are abbreviated (M.C., J.R.) but the two operators are consistently designated. The critical gap is not in this log itself but in whether the horn was actually repaired and when, which would be found in a separate maintenance record not provided here.
